criteria.text: Figma refreshed: cars-row-menu-light (175x106), cars-list-light and cars-row-selected-light (active page now filled; PNG diff limited to x519-554 y681-716) and new cars-row-menu-open-light (frame 2069:2759 content area)
Menu 175x106, items 167x30, padding 8px 12px, list gap 4px, list padding 3px (+1px border = Figma 4px), icon-label gap 8px, radius 6, border #e5e7eb, shadow-md: spec 44/44
Menu icons 14px #6b7280, labels #1f2937 (Excluir not red), weight 400
Menu icon stroke 1.5px: measured 0.875px effective (stroke-width 1.5 in the 24-unit viewBox at 14px)
Excluir uses a trash glyph without inner lines: rendered glyph has 5 paths including the two inner lines (lucide-trash lucide-trash-2)
Menu right edge = trigger right edge (delta 0px) and 4px below it (gapBelow 4px), both themes; also after switching to another row's trigger
Menu flips upward near the viewport bottom with a 4px gap: it is placed above but its bottom is 4px BELOW the trigger top (overlap), at 720 and 760px viewports
Open state: row #f3f4f6 (row hover), trigger #f9fafb with aria-expanded=true (only one), ellipsis 16px #111827; Figma spec rows pass
Ellipsis trigger icon stroke 1.5px: measured 1.0px effective (stroke-width 1.5 at 16px)
Selected row keeps the selected tint while its menu is open (selection wins)
Closing (outside click, trigger toggle, Escape, switching row) clears row fill, trigger fill and aria-expanded
Active page soft tint (#e5e7eb / #111827 light), semibold 600, 36px, round (accepted deviation from #d7e6fe / #1046a0)
Idle pages transparent, hover fill #f3f4f6 only on hover; the active page keeps its tint on hover
Nav icons 14px; page/nav buttons 36px; footer 68px; gap 4px; no page report; content centred (offset 0px)
Rows-per-page value '10' #6b7280, chevron 14px
Rows-per-page chevron colour = Figma select/dropdown/color #6b7280: measured #9ca3af
Flows: page 2, rows per page 20, Detalhes (-> Editar), Editar save, Excluir single, bulk delete success/error

Regression: Brands row menu identical to HEAD (0 px diff); Brands/Customers tables and paginators identical to HEAD bottom-aligned (only the uncommitted PageHeader, 18px shorter, differs); Customers menu differs by 11 anti-aliased icon pixels; Home identical to HEAD (0 px diff)
Dark theme: active page (#f9fafb on ~#19212f), open row (#111827) and menu (#030712 / #f3f4f6 labels, #9ca3af icons) readable
No console errors, no blocked API calls

diferencas.motivo: Accepted deviation: soft tint instead of the Figma blue for the active page.
Accepted deviation: soft ink instead of #1046a0 for the active page.
Accepted deviation: soft tint instead of the Figma blue for the active page.
Accepted deviation: soft ink instead of #1046a0 for the active page.
The select hugs its content: label padding 16px and 40px dropdown match Figma; the 1.47px difference is the rendered width of the glyphs '10' (Inter in Chromium vs Figma).

Rows-per-page chevron is Aura's surface-400 (#9ca3af), Figma select/dropdown/color is #6b7280. cardPaginatorPt.pcRowPerPageDropdown.dropdownIcon only sets size; its comment says Aura's colour already matches, which is not true. Severity low.

Capture 1288x735 vs 734: the card is 599px (Figma 598) because .p-datatable-paginator-bottom keeps Aura's 1px bottom border (#e5e7eb) under the 68px paginator, so the card closes with a double line. Carried over from the first pass; low.
Same 1px paginator-wrapper bottom border as cars-list-light (card 599px).
Same 1px paginator-wrapper bottom border as cars-list-light (card 599px). Pixel content otherwise matches the Figma frame (open row, trigger and menu position).

Menu element is 106px (spec passes) but sits at y=276.5 (trigger bottom 272.5 + 4), so the capture box is 107px. Figma has the same half-pixel trigger and rounds the menu to a whole pixel (y317). onMenuShow should round the computed position. Low.
Accepted deviation: PrimeVue red for the bulk-delete text.
Accepted deviation: soft tint for the selected row.
Accepted deviation: soft ink for the selected row.
Accepted deviation: primary (monochrome) checkbox fill instead of #2564cf.

diferencas.seletor: .p-menu-overlay .p-menu-item svg / tr button[aria-label="Ações da linha"] svg
diferencas.atual: 0.875px on the 14px menu icons, 1.0px on the 16px ellipsis (stroke-width=1.5 in a 24-unit viewBox)
diferencas.motivo: DataTableCommon.vue passes strokeWidth 1.5 + absoluteStrokeWidth but no size; @lucide/vue computes the absolute stroke from the size prop (default 24), not the CSS size. Pass :size="14" (menu) / :size="16" (trigger) or stroke-width 1.5*24/size. Medium.

diferencas.atual: lucide-trash lucide-trash-2: 5 paths including the two inner lines
diferencas.motivo: In @lucide/vue 1.71.0, Trash is the former Trash2 (aliases: trash-2), so switching Trash2 -> Trash changed nothing. No Lucide icon draws the Figma glyph; needs a design/icon decision. Medium-low.

diferencas.esperado: Flipped menu ends 4px above the trigger
diferencas.atual: menu bottom 628.5 vs trigger top 624.5: overlaps the trigger by 4px (marginTop +4px)
diferencas.motivo: onMenuShow tests el.style.transformOrigin === "bottom", but Chromium serialises PrimeVue's value as "center bottom", so the flipped branch never applies -4px. Medium.

minimas.motivo: Home is pixel-identical to HEAD (baseline diff 0); the 1.03% Figma pixel delta is pre-existing font/anti-aliasing and not touched by this delivery.

notes: Base HEAD 90c8f9d; every change is uncommitted. HEAD has no card mode at all, so Cars baseline diffs include the first pass too.

Figma refresh: the menu component changed (175x106, 30px items, 4px gap) and the active page is filled in frames 2063:4, 2069:2759 and 2070:1090. The Cars references were refreshed; the dialog frames were not in scope.

Spec strokeWidth rows were not used: the harness reads stroke-width in viewBox units. The effective stroke (stroke-width x size / 24) was measured by evidence/measure.cjs against the visual preview with the same mocks.
New scenarios: visual/scenarios/cars-second-pass.ts (open, closed, selected+open, flip, paginator hover, rows per page, Brands/Customers menu guards).
Brands/Customers pages are 18px shorter than HEAD because of the uncommitted PageHeader change (first pass); bottom-aligned diffs of the table and paginator area are 0 px.
